help.Expected: The plan's expected net for this event, copied when it matched its plan action (its share of it). A flip's buy or a craft carries its chain's profit. "—" = it matched no plan action
help.Expected ROI: Expected profit ÷ buy cost. Flips need at least 20%
help.Expected mats: Average disenchant results for this quality and item level
help.Expected net: What this action adds on average, after fees, deposits and the chance it sells. A chain counts it once, on its first action
help.Expected profit: Average profit after fees and the chance it sells; owned mats count at their hold value
help.Item: The item, in its quality colour. Click to open it on auctionhouse.fyi
help.Mats each: Gold for mats you must buy, per craft. "—" = you own them all
help.Paid each: What you paid per unit, averaged across all your characters; 0 for items you found or held before tracking started
help.Plan: What this week's plan does with it
help.Plan action: The plan action this event completed: done, partial, or missed and skipped ones
help.Position: "cheapest" at or below the cheapest listing now; else how many units are listed below you, and at what prices
help.Price: Each, copper as the AH or vendor charged it; for Paid out, the gold taken from the mailbox
help.Price age: How long ago the buy price was seen. Older prices are less likely to still be there
help.Profit if sold: Listed total after the 5% cut, less the cost
help.Qty: Units (or crafts) this row is about
help.Realized: What it actually made: a post its payout after cost and deposit, the deposit lost when it expired; a chain's buy or craft what its posts made so far. Green at or above Expected, amber below
help.Recipe known by: The character who knows it, and their skill
help.Risk: Gold this action spends ÷ all your gold. Amber above 25%
help.Seasonality Strength: 0–100: how predictable the weekly price pattern is, tested on a held-out week. Not how profitable it is. "—" = too little evidence
help.Sell each: Expected sell price per unit at the sell slot
help.Sell slot: When to sell: the peak hour the flip is for
help.Source: Where the mats come from: Owned, AH, Mixed, + crafted (another character makes a reagent first)
help.Supply/Volume: Days of supply: current supply ÷ sales per day. Not a time-to-sell guarantee
help.Time left: The time left the AH shows for the auction
help.Value each: What one product is expected to sell for
help.When: When it happened, in your local time
help.Where: Bags, bank or mail. Auctions you have up are on On the AH
help.Why: How far the peak's price is above the 30-day median
help.Worth: What it is expected to bring under its plan: planned sales after fees and the chance they sell, other units at their hold value
help.ilvl: Item level: sets the disenchant results

help.Action: What to do: BUY, POST, DE (disenchant), CRAFT, VENDOR, MAIL or HOLD
help.Best selling windows: The hours of the week it sells best (price × buyers), local time. "early pattern" = under 3 weeks of data
help.Buy: Cheapest buyout on the AH now
help.Buy each: Price to pay now, per unit (buy at or below it)
help.Chance: Chance it sells in its planned window. The dot is the confidence in that chance: green ≥ 75%, amber ≥ 45%, grey below. Hover a cell for the exact %
help.Character: Which of your characters does it
help.Cooldown: When the recipe can be used again
help.Cost each: What it cost you per unit: what you paid, or the mats for a craft; 0 for items you found or held before tracking started
help.Crafts: How many to make: stops where one more would lose money
help.Current Supply: Units on the AH now, in the newest scan
help.Deposit: Deposit you paid to post; back on a sale, lost on expiry. "—" = its post was not captured
help.Detail: The deposit, the post it resolved, what it cost or realized, or why the plan action was missed
help.EV: Expected value of the mats: average results × their sell value
